=== ./SPEED_TEST_FIX.md ===
# Исправление Speed Test Upload

## Проблема
`fetch()` API возвращает promise сразу после отправки запроса на сервер, **не дожидаясь** полной передачи данных через сеть. Поэтому замер upload скорости показывает завышенные/некорректные значения.

## Решение
Использовать `XMLHttpRequest` с событием `upload.progress` для отслеживания реального прогресса отправки данных.

## Инструкция по применению

### Вариант 1: Замена функции в docs/index.html

Найти в `docs/index.html` функцию `measureUpload()` (строка ~500-530) и заменить её на:

```javascript
async function measureUpload() {
    els.speedPhase.textContent = "Measuring upload...";
    setGauge(0, "upload");
    
    const chunkSize = 256 * 1024; // 256KB chunks
    const chunk = new Uint8Array(chunkSize);
    crypto.getRandomValues(chunk);
    
    const totalChunks = Math.floor(SPEED.maxUploadBytes / chunkSize);
    const parts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < totalChunks; i++) parts.push(chunk);
    const bigPayload = new Blob(parts);
    
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        const start = performance.now();
        let lastReport = start;
        let lastLoaded = 0;
        
        xhr.upload.addEventListener("progress", (e) => {
            if (state.speedAbort) {
                xhr.abort();
                resolve(null);
                return;
            }
            
            const now = performance.now();
            if (e.lengthComputable && now - lastReport > 200) {
                const elapsed = (now - lastReport) / 1000;
                const uploaded = e.loaded - lastLoaded;
                const instantMbps = formatMbps(uploaded / elapsed);
                
                setGauge(instantMbps, "upload");
                speedLog(`upload ${Math.round(e.loaded / 1024)} KB / ${Math.round(e.total / 1024)} KB`, `${instantMbps.toFixed(2)} Mbps`);
                
                lastReport = now;
                lastLoaded = e.loaded;
            }
        });
        
        xhr.addEventListener("load", () => {
            const totalElapsed = (performance.now() - start) / 1000;
            const bytes = bigPayload.size;
            
            if (totalElapsed <= 0 || bytes <= 0) {
                resolve(null);
                return;
            }
            
            const mbps = formatMbps(bytes / totalElapsed);
            setGauge(mbps, "upload");
            speedLog(`upload complete ${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`, `${mbps.toFixed(2)} Mbps`);
            resolve(mbps);
        });
        
        xhr.addEventListener("error", () => {
            speedLog("upload", "network error");
            resolve(null);
        });
        
        xhr.addEventListener("abort", () => {
            speedLog("upload", "aborted");
            resolve(null);
        });
        
        xhr.open("POST", SPEED.uploadUrl, true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream");
        xhr.send(bigPayload);
    });
}
```

### Вариант 2: Использовать готовый файл

Скопировать код из `docs/speedtest-fix.js` и вставить в нужное место в `docs/index.html`.

---

## Что изменилось

| Было (fetch) | Стало (XMLHttpRequest) |
|--------------|------------------------|
| ❌ Замер завершается сразу после `.fetch()` | ✅ Замер идёт во время реальной отправки данных |
| ❌ Нет отслеживания прогресса | ✅ Событие `upload.progress` каждые 200ms |
| ❌ Невозможно увидеть промежуточные значения | ✅ Анимация спидометра и лог в реальном времени |
| ❌ Некорректные результаты | ✅ Точные замеры скорости upload |

---

## Техническая информация

**Старый код (fetch):**
```javascript
const response = await fetch(SPEED.uploadUrl, { method: "POST", body: bigPayload });
const elapsed = (performance.now() - start) / 1000;
```
- `fetch()` возвращает promise **после отправки заголовков**, не дожидаясь передачи тела запроса.
- Таймер останавливается слишком рано.

**Новый код (XHR):**
```javascript
xhr.upload.addEventListener("progress", (e) => {
    const uploaded = e.loaded - lastLoaded;
    const instantMbps = formatMbps(uploaded / elapsed);
});
```
- Событие `progress` срабатывает во время реальной передачи данных по сети.
- Вычисляется мгновенная скорость между двумя замерами (differential measurement).

---

## Совместимость

✅ Все современные браузеры (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)  
✅ Мобильные браузеры (iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile)  
✅ Работает с CORS (если сервер поддерживает)

## Тестирование

После применения патча:

1. Открыть Dashboard → Speed Test
2. Нажать "Start test"
3. Проверить:
   - ✅ Ping измеряется корректно
   - ✅ Download измеряется корректно
   - ✅ **Upload теперь показывает реальную скорость** (не мгновенное завершение)
   - ✅ Лог показывает промежуточные значения во время upload
   - ✅ Спидометр плавно анимируется

---

## Альтернативный подход (если нужен Fetch API)

Если хочешь остаться на `fetch()`, можно использовать **ReadableStream** для upload:

```javascript
const stream = new ReadableStream({
    start(controller) {
        let sent = 0;
        const interval = setInterval(() => {
            if (sent >= bigPayload.size) {
                controller.close();
                clearInterval(interval);
                return;
            }
            const chunk = bigPayload.slice(sent, sent + chunkSize);
            controller.enqueue(chunk);
            sent += chunk.size;
            // Track progress here
        }, 100);
    }
});

await fetch(SPEED.uploadUrl, { method: "POST", body: stream });
```

Но это **сложнее** и **менее надёжно**, чем XHR с `upload.progress`.

---

**Рекомендация:** используй исправление с `XMLHttpRequest` — это стандартный способ для upload progress tracking.

**Решение:**

- Используется `XMLHttpRequest` с событием `upload.progress` для отслеживания реального прогресса отправки данных
- Добавлена анимация спидометра и промежуточные значения в лог

**Применение:**

### 2️⃣ Получить бесплатный домен и пропустить через переводчик

**Ответ: НЕ МОГУ** ❌

**Причина:**
- У меня нет доступа к внешним сервисам регистрации доменов
- Не могу напрямую взаимодействовать с Freenom, Cloudflare, Google Translate API и т.д.

**Что ты можешь сделать сам:**

#### Вариант 1: Бесплатный домен
- **Freenom** (`.tk`, `.ml`, `.ga`, `.cf`, `.gq`) — бесплатно на 12 месяцев
- **InfinityFree** — бесплатный хостинг + поддомен
- **Cloudflare Pages** — custom domain бесплатно (нужен купленный домен от $0.99/год)

#### Вариант 2: Проксирование через Google Translate (уже есть)
```
https://translate.google.com/translate?sl=en&tl=ru&u=https://b3b3097.github.io/REMAININGCONNECTIONS/
```
**Минусы:**
- ❌ Ненадёжно (Google может заблокировать)
- ❌ Медленно
- ❌ Ломает JavaScript/CSS

#### Вариант 3: Cloudflare Workers (рекомендуется)
```javascript
// worker.js - бесплатный прокси для обхода блокировок
addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  event.respondWith(handleRequest(event.request))
})

async function handleRequest(request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const targetUrl = 'https://b3b3097.github.io' + url.pathname
  const response = await fetch(targetUrl)
  return new Response(response.body, {
    status: response.status,
    headers: response.headers
  })
}
```
Привязать к домену: `proxy.yourdomain.com` → обход блокировок

#### Вариант 4: GitHub Pages custom domain
1. Купить дешёвый домен (~$1/год на Namecheap)
2. Settings → Pages → Custom domain → `yourdomain.com`
3. Бесплатный SSL от GitHub

### 3️⃣ Почему нет авто-запуска новых прокси/подписок/утилит? 6 часов — долго, раз в час!

**Было:**
- Subscriptions: каждые **2 часа** (`*/2`)
- TG Proxies: каждый **час** (`*`) ✅
- Utilities: каждые **6 часов** (`*/6`)
- Search Queries: каждые **6 часов** (`*/6`)

**Стало (исправлено):**
- ✅ Subscriptions: каждый **час** (`cron: "15 * * * *"`)
- ✅ TG Proxies: каждый **час** (`cron: "35 * * * *"`) — без изменений
- ✅ Utilities: каждый **час** (`cron: "20 * * * *"`)
- ✅ Search Queries: каждый **час** (`cron: "40 * * * *"`)

**Изменённые файлы:**
1. `.github/workflows/subscription-discovery.yml`
2. `.github/workflows/utils-discovery.yml`
3. `.github/workflows/search-query-generator.yml`

**Расписание по минутам:**
```
:15 — Subscriptions Discovery
:20 — Utils Discovery
:35 — TG Proxy Discovery
:40 — Search Query Generator
```
Разнесены по времени, чтобы не конкурировать за API rate limits.

**⚠️ Важно:**
GitHub Actions бесплатный лимит: **2000 минут/месяц**

Каждый запуск:
- Subscriptions: ~20-40 минут
- TG Proxies: ~30-50 минут
- Utils: ~40-60 минут
- Queries: ~5 минут

Итого: ~100 минут/час × 24 часа × 30 дней = **~72000 минут/месяц** 💥

**Решение:**
- Либо платный план GitHub ($4/мес за 3000 минут)
- Либо уменьшить лимиты запросов (`max_repos`, `max_probe`)
- Либо запускать реже (каждые 2-3 часа)

**Рекомендация:**
Оставить **каждые 2 часа** для Subscriptions/Utils, **каждый час** только для TG Proxies (самый востребованный).

## ⚠️ Предупреждения

### GitHub Actions лимиты
При запуске **всех** workflows каждый час расход будет:
- ~100 минут/час
- ~2400 минут/день
- ~72000 минут/месяц

**Это превысит бесплатный лимит в 36 раз!**

### Рекомендуемое расписание (компромисс)
```yaml
# Subscriptions: каждые 2 часа (экономия 50%)
cron: "15 */2 * * *"

# TG Proxies: каждый час (важный, оставляем)
cron: "35 * * * *"

# Utils: каждые 3 часа (экономия 66%)
cron: "20 */3 * * *"

# Queries: каждые 6 часов (достаточно)
cron: "40 */6 * * *"
```

**Итого:** ~20-30 минут/час × 24 часа × 30 дней = **~18000 минут/месяц**
Всё равно много, но **ближе к реальности**.

      "last_commit_message": "Kubernetes, read-only — and give the monitor a shape that survives six modules\n\n## The UX problem, which was mine and which I created incrementally\n\nEvery module built today appended a panel to the Fleet Monitor. Each one\nlooked reasonable on its own. The composite did not: with all modules on,\nthe page opened with FIVE stacked forms — search, a command box, a log\ntailer, a cron reader, a container list — above the health summary and the\nserver cards. The thing the page is named for sat below four tools nobody\nwas using at that moment.\n\nThe monitor now has sub-navigation: Overview plus one tab per enabled\nmodule. Overview is the default and holds what the page is for.\n\nPanels stay MOUNTED and are hidden rather than unmounted. A running\nbroadcast or an open log tail has to survive a glance at the overview — and\nLogTailPanel stops its remote command on unmount, so unmounting on tab\nswitch would kill a tail mid-read. A module switched off while its tab is\nopen falls back to Overview rather than leaving a blank page.\n\n## Kubernetes\n\nThe roadmap says doing this badly is worse than not doing it, so the file\nstates where the line is rather than leaving it to be discovered:\n\n- No context switching. `kubectl config use-context` rewrites the user's\n  kubeconfig for every process on that host. A tool that repoints someone's\n  cluster because they used a dropdown is how a manifest reaches prod\n  believing it is staging. Context is passed per read with `--context`.\n- No exec. That is `docker exec` with more blast radius and a separate RBAC\n  story; it belongs behind broadcast's approval model, not a button beside\n  a pod name.\n- Nothing that writes.\n\nRBAC is what makes this different from Docker, and it is handled as data\nrather than as an error: `--all-namespaces` is the common denial, so pods\nfall back to the current namespace and the result records WHICH happened —\nan empty list means something different depending on it, and the panel says\nso. Six failure classes, each with its own remedy: forbidden is checked\nbefore no-cluster because an RBAC denial mentions the server too.\n\n`--request-timeout` on every call, because kubectl otherwise waits forever\nand a dead cluster would hang the exec with no output. The ready column is\nrebuilt from container booleans into the `1/2` operators expect, and\nrestarts report the worst container rather than the first — a pod with one\ncalm container and one crashlooping is a crashlooping pod.\n\n## Three bugs inherited from the modules written hours earlier\n\nThe Docker/cron review landed after this parser was written, and it had all\nthree of the classes that review found:\n\n- `no such file or directory` in a kubeconfig path error was classified as\n  a missing binary — the \"go fix the wrong machine\" failure. `not-installed`\n  is now restricted to shell wordings and checked after the specific cases.\n- The section regex required `===\\n`, so a CRLF host matched no marker and\n  reported an empty cluster. Now `\\r?\\n`.\n- Error-word matching ran over data lines, so a namespace called\n  `error-reporting` vanished. Namespaces are now decided by SHAPE — one\n  token that is a valid Kubernetes name — which is immune to what anyone\n  calls a resource. My first attempt still dropped `unauthorized-probe`,\n  because a hyphen is a word boundary; the test caught it.\n\nAlso corrects the Docker module description, which advertised \"open a shell\ninside one\" while `buildDockerShellCommand` was wired to nothing. Both the\nreviewer and I reached the same conclusion independently: correct the claim\nrather than ship an unreviewed exec path to make it true.\n\n22 tests for Kubernetes, including the three inherited classes. 1852\npassing, lint and typecheck clean, boots clean.\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>",

=== ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml ===
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'data/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy.yml'
      - 'scripts/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages-deploy-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  DOCS_DIR: "docs"
  DATA_DIR: "data"

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Ensure directory structure
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "${DOCS_DIR}" "${DATA_DIR}"
          echo "[+] Directories ready"

      - name: Copy data into docs (so it is served by Pages)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "${DOCS_DIR}/data"
          # Copy all JSON files from root data/ into docs/data/
          if compgen -G "${DATA_DIR}/*.json" > /dev/null; then
            cp ${DATA_DIR}/*.json "${DOCS_DIR}/data/"
            echo "[+] Copied JSON data files to ${DOCS_DIR}/data/:"
            ls -la "${DOCS_DIR}/data/"
          else
            echo "[!] No JSON files found in ${DATA_DIR}/ — site will use demo data"
          fi

      - name: Validate JSON data integrity
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y jq
          fi
          echo "[*] Checking JSON files..."
          find ${DOCS_DIR}/data -name "*.json" -type f 2>/dev/null | while read -r file; do
            if ! jq empty "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "[ERROR] Malformed JSON: $file"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "[OK] $file"
          done || true
          echo "[+] JSON validation complete"

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./${{ env.DOCS_DIR }}
          retention-days: 14

  deploy:
    name: Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    timeout-minutes: 10
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

      - name: Summary
        run: |
          echo "============================================"
          echo " Deployment successful"
          echo "============================================"
          echo " URL: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}"
          echo " Time: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
          echo "============================================"
=== ./.github/workflows/search-query-generator.yml ===
name: Search Query Generator

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "40 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: "Dry run: не коммитить результаты"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      commit_generated:
        description: "Коммитить сгенерированные запросы"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      target:
        description: "Целевой проект/репозиторий"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      max_repo_queries:
        description: "Лимит запросов для репозиториев"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "1200"
      max_code_queries:
        description: "Лимит запросов для кода"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "800"
      seed:
        description: "Seed"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "1337"

concurrency:
  group: search-query-generator
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11"
  OUTPUT_DIR: ".github/generated"
  GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  TARGET: ${{ github.event.inputs.target || '' }}
  MAX_REPO_QUERIES: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_repo_queries || '1200' }}
  MAX_CODE_QUERIES: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_code_queries || '800' }}
  SEED: ${{ github.event.inputs.seed || '1337' }}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  generate:
    name: Generate queries
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
      - name: Generate
        run: |
          mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
          python <<'PY'
          import json, os, hashlib, random, re, datetime as dt
          from collections import Counter

          seed = int(os.getenv("SEED", "1337"))
          random.seed(seed)
          out_dir = os.getenv("OUTPUT_DIR", ".github/generated")
          os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

          SUB_PROTOCOLS = ["vless","vmess","xray","reality","sing-box","singbox","clash","clash-meta","mihomo","shadowsocks","trojan","hysteria","hysteria2","tuic","wireguard","proxy","vpn"]
          SUB_INTENTS_EN = ["subscription","subscriptions","sub","nodes","free nodes","proxy list","aggregator","mirror","archive","daily update"]
          SUB_INTENTS_RU = ["подписка","подписки","узлы","конфиги","обход блокировок","остаться на связи","рабочие подписки"]
          TG_PROTOCOLS = ["mtproto","mtproxy","telegram proxy","tg proxy","t.me proxy"]
          TG_INTENTS_EN = ["proxy","proxies","mtproto proxy","mtproxy list","free proxy","secret"]
          TG_INTENTS_RU = ["телеграм прокси","тг прокси","мтпрокси","прокси список","бесплатный прокси"]
          UTIL_PROTOCOLS = ["v2ray","xray","vless","vmess","sing-box","clash","mihomo","shadowsocks","trojan","hysteria","wireguard","proxy","vpn"]
          UTIL_INTENTS_EN = ["client","gui","app","manager","dashboard","desktop","mobile","release"]
          UTIL_INTENTS_RU = ["клиент","приложение","программа","интерфейс","менеджер","утилита"]
          PLATFORMS = ["android","ios","windows","linux","macos","desktop","mobile"]
          TOPICS = ["v2ray","xray","vless","vmess","reality","sing-box","clash","mihomo","shadowsocks","trojan","hysteria","tuic","wireguard","proxy","vpn","subscription","mtproto","mtproxy"]
          SUB_FILENAMES = ["sub.txt","subscribe.txt","subscription.txt","v2ray.txt","nodes.txt","proxy.txt","clash.yaml","config.yaml","mihomo.yaml","sing-box.json"]
          TG_FILENAMES = ["mtproxy.txt","tg-proxy.txt","telegram-proxy.txt","proxy.txt","list.txt","mtproxy.json"]

          def cs(v):
              return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", v or "").strip()

          def qid(q):
              return hashlib.md5(q.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]

          def bq(*parts):
              c = []
              for p in parts:
                  if not p:
                      continue
                  p = cs(str(p))
                  if p:
                      c.append(p)
              return cs(" ".join(c))

          def entry(cat, qt, q, pri, reason, qual=None):
              q = cs(q)
              if not q:
                  return None
              qual = qual or []
              fq = cs(" ".join([q] + qual))
              return {"id": qid(fq), "category": cat, "type": qt, "query": q, "full_query": fq, "qualifiers": qual, "priority": pri, "reason": reason}

          def finalize(entries, limit, cat, qt):
              seen = set()
              uniq = []
              for e in entries:
                  if not e:
                      continue
                  k = cs(e["full_query"].lower())
                  if k in seen:
                      continue
                  seen.add(k)
                  uniq.append(e)
              for e in uniq:
                  e["_n"] = random.random()
              uniq.sort(key=lambda x: (x["priority"], x["_n"]), reverse=True)
              if limit > 0 and len(uniq) > limit:
                  uniq = uniq[:limit]
              res = []
              for i, e in enumerate(uniq, 1):
                  e.pop("_n", None)
                  e["slug"] = f"{cat}-{qt}-{i:04d}"
                  res.append(e)
              return res

          def sub_repo():
              e = []
              for p in SUB_PROTOCOLS:
                  for i in SUB_INTENTS_EN:
                      e.append(entry("subscriptions", "repo", bq(p, i), 92, "protocol+intent", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              for i in SUB_INTENTS_RU:
                  e.append(entry("subscriptions", "repo", bq(p, i), 88, "protocol+ru", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              for p in SUB_PROTOCOLS:
                  for pl in PLATFORMS:
                      e.append(entry("subscriptions", "repo", bq(p, pl, "subscription"), 84, "protocol+platform", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              now = dt.datetime.utcnow()
              for d in [7, 30, 90, 180]:
                  date = (now - dt.timedelta(days=d)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                  for p in SUB_PROTOCOLS[:10]:
                      e.append(entry("subscriptions", "repo", bq(p, "subscription", f"pushed:>{date}"), 80, "recent", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              return e

          def sub_code():
              e = []
              terms = SUB_PROTOCOLS + SUB_INTENTS_EN
              for t in terms:
                  for f in SUB_FILENAMES:
                      e.append(entry("subscriptions", "code", bq(t, f"filename:{f}"), 86, "term+filename"))
              return e

          def sub_topic():
              return [entry("subscriptions", "topic", f"topic:{t}", 80, "topic", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]) for t in TOPICS]

          def tg_repo():
              e = []
              for t in TG_PROTOCOLS + TG_INTENTS_EN + TG_INTENTS_RU:
                  e.append(entry("tg_proxies", "repo", bq(t), 90, "tg base", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              for p in TG_PROTOCOLS:
                  for i in TG_INTENTS_EN:
                      e.append(entry("tg_proxies", "repo", bq(p, i), 92, "tg proto+intent", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              return e

          def tg_code():
              e = []
              for t in TG_PROTOCOLS + TG_INTENTS_EN:
                  for f in TG_FILENAMES:
                      e.append(entry("tg_proxies", "code", bq(t, f"filename:{f}"), 88, "tg term+filename"))
              for pat in ["tg://proxy", "t.me/proxy", "server port secret", "mtproxy secret"]:
                  e.append(entry("tg_proxies", "code", pat, 95, "tg pattern"))
              return e

          def util_repo():
              e = []
              for p in UTIL_PROTOCOLS:
                  for i in UTIL_INTENTS_EN:
                      e.append(entry("utilities", "repo", bq(p, i), 92, "util proto+intent", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              for i in UTIL_INTENTS_RU:
                  e.append(entry("utilities", "repo", bq(p, i), 85, "util proto+ru", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              for p in UTIL_PROTOCOLS:
                  for pl in PLATFORMS:
                      e.append(entry("utilities", "repo", bq(p, pl, "client"), 90, "util proto+platform", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]))
              return e

          def util_code():
              e = []
              for t in (UTIL_PROTOCOLS + UTIL_INTENTS_EN)[:40]:
                  e.append(entry("utilities", "code", bq(t, "filename:README.md"), 70, "util term+filename"))
              return e

          def util_topic():
              return [entry("utilities", "topic", f"topic:{t}", 82, "util topic", ["fork:true", "archived:false"]) for t in TOPICS + ["client", "gui", "app", "release"]]

          mr = int(os.getenv("MAX_REPO_QUERIES", "1200"))
          mc = int(os.getenv("MAX_CODE_QUERIES", "800"))

          sr = finalize(sub_repo(), mr, "subscriptions", "repo")
          sc = finalize(sub_code(), mc, "subscriptions", "code")
          st = finalize(sub_topic(), 300, "subscriptions", "topic")
          tr = finalize(tg_repo(), mr, "tg_proxies", "repo")
          tc = finalize(tg_code(), mc, "tg_proxies", "code")
          ur = finalize(util_repo(), mr, "utilities", "repo")
          uc = finalize(util_code(), mc, "utilities", "code")
          ut = finalize(util_topic(), 300, "utilities", "topic")

          payload = {
              "generated_at": dt.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
              "generator": "search-query-generator.yml",
              "target": os.getenv("TARGET", ""),
              "categories": {
                  "subscriptions": {"repo": sr, "code": sc, "topic": st},
                  "tg_proxies": {"repo": tr, "code": tc},
                  "utilities": {"repo": ur, "code": uc, "topic": ut},
              },
              "summary": {
                  "subscriptions_repo": len(sr),
                  "subscriptions_code": len(sc),
                  "subscriptions_topic": len(st),
                  "tg_proxies_repo": len(tr),
                  "tg_proxies_code": len(tc),
                  "utilities_repo": len(ur),
                  "utilities_code": len(uc),
                  "utilities_topic": len(ut),
              }
          }

          with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "queries.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          for qt, entries in [("repo", sr), ("code", sc), ("topic", st)]:
              with open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"queries_subscriptions_{qt}.txt"), "w") as f:
                  for e in entries:
                      f.write(e["full_query"] + "\n")
              mx = [{"slug": e["slug"], "query": e["query"], "full_query": e["full_query"], "priority": e["priority"]} for e in entries]
              with open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"matrix_subscriptions_{qt}.json"), "w") as f:
                  json.dump(mx, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          for qt, entries in [("repo", tr), ("code", tc)]:
              with open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"queries_tg_proxies_{qt}.txt"), "w") as f:
                  for e in entries:
                      f.write(e["full_query"] + "\n")
              mx = [{"slug": e["slug"], "query": e["query"], "full_query": e["full_query"], "priority": e["priority"]} for e in entries]
              with open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"matrix_tg_proxies_{qt}.json"), "w") as f:
                  json.dump(mx, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          for qt, entries in [("repo", ur), ("code", uc), ("topic", ut)]:
              with open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"queries_utilities_{qt}.txt"), "w") as f:
                  for e in entries:
                      f.write(e["full_query"] + "\n")
              mx = [{"slug": e["slug"], "query": e["query"], "full_query": e["full_query"], "priority": e["priority"]} for e in entries]
              with open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"matrix_utilities_{qt}.json"), "w") as f:
                  json.dump(mx, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          print("=== Summary ===")
          for k, v in payload["summary"].items():
              print(f"{k}: {v}")
          print(f"Total: {sum(payload['summary'].values())}")
          PY
      - name: Validate JSON
        run: |
          python -c "
          import json, glob
          files = glob.glob('.github/generated/**/*.json', recursive=True)
          for f in files:
              with open(f) as fh:
                  json.load(fh)
              print(f'[OK] {f}')
          print(f'Validated {len(files)} files')
          "
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: generated-queries
          path: .github/generated/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Commit
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run != true && github.event.inputs.commit_generated != false }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .github/generated/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No changes"
          else
            git commit -m "chore(queries): auto-generate [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi
=== ./.github/workflows/subscription-discovery.yml ===
name: Subscription Discovery Pipeline

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "15 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: "Dry run: не коммитить результаты"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      max_repos:
        description: "Сколько репозиториев искать за запрос"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "80"
      max_probe:
        description: "Сколько кандидатов проверять"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "220"
      include_gitverse:
        description: "Искать в Gitverse"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      skip_search:
        description: "Пропустить поиск (только проверка существующих данных)"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: subscription-discovery
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
  checks: write

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11"
  OUTPUT_DIR: "data"
  OUTPUT_FILE: "data/subscriptions_found.json"
  GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  USER_AGENT: "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 REMAININGCONNECTIONS/1.0"

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  prepare:
    name: 1 - Prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests pyyaml

      - name: Create directories
        run: |
          mkdir -p raw candidates "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
          echo "[+] Directories created"

      - name: Write run metadata
        env:
          MAX_REPOS: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_repos || '80' }}
          MAX_PROBE: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_probe || '220' }}
        run: |
          python <<'PY'
          import json, datetime, os
          payload = {
              "run_id": "${{ github.run_id }}",
              "run_number": "${{ github.run_number }}",
              "workflow": "subscription-discovery",
              "repository": "${{ github.repository }}",
              "actor": "${{ github.actor }}",
              "event_name": "${{ github.event_name }}",
              "ref": "${{ github.ref }}",
              "sha": "${{ github.sha }}",
              "generated_at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
              "max_repos": os.getenv("MAX_REPOS", "80"),
              "max_probe": os.getenv("MAX_PROBE", "220"),
              "include_gitverse": "${{ github.event.inputs.include_gitverse }}" != "false",
              "dry_run": "${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}" == "true",
              "skip_search": "${{ github.event.inputs.skip_search }}" == "true",
          }
          os.makedirs("raw", exist_ok=True)
          with open("raw/run_metadata.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
          print("[+] Metadata saved")
          PY

      - name: Upload metadata
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: prepare-metadata
          path: raw/run_metadata.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  search-github-keywords:
    name: 2 - Search GitHub keywords
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: prepare
    if: ${{ github.event.inputs.skip_search != true }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    continue-on-error: true
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - slug: v2ray
            query: "v2ray OR xray OR vless OR vmess"
          - slug: singbox
            query: "sing-box OR singbox"
          - slug: clash
            query: "clash OR clash-meta OR mihomo"
          - slug: shadowsocks
            query: "shadowsocks OR shadowsocks-rust"
          - slug: trojan
            query: "trojan OR trojan-go"
          - slug: hysteria
            query: "hysteria OR hysteria2 OR hy2"
          - slug: reality
            query: "reality OR vless-reality"
          - slug: vless
            query: "vless OR vless-sub"
          - slug: vmess
            query: "vmess OR vmess-sub"
          - slug: tuic
            query: "tuic OR tuic-v5"
          - slug: wireguard
            query: "wireguard OR wg"
          - slug: free-nodes
            query: "free-nodes OR free nodes OR free subscription"
          - slug: aggregation
            query: "subscription aggregation OR proxy aggregation"
          - slug: ru-net
            query: "обход блокировок OR подписка прокси"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install utilities
        run: sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y jq
      - name: Search repos
        env:
          QUERY: ${{ matrix.query }}
          SLUG: ${{ matrix.slug }}
          MAX_REPOS: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_repos || '80' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p raw
          OUT="raw/github_repos_${SLUG}.jsonl"
          API_OUT="raw/github_repos_api_${SLUG}.json"
          : > "${OUT}"
          FULL_QUERY="${QUERY} in:name,description,readme fork:true archived:false"
          if ! gh api -X GET search/repositories -f q="${FULL_QUERY}" -f per_page="${MAX_REPOS}" -f sort=updated -f order=desc > "${API_OUT}" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo '{"items":[]}' > "${API_OUT}"
          fi
          jq -c '.items[]? | {source:"github",kind:"repo",repo:.full_name,url:.html_url,path:null,score:.score,stars:.stargazers_count,updated_at:.updated_at,pushed_at:.pushed_at,description:.description} | select(.repo != null)' "${API_OUT}" >> "${OUT}" 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "[+] Found: $(wc -l < "${OUT}")"
          sleep $((RANDOM % 7 + 3))
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: search-github-keyword-${{ matrix.slug }}
          path: raw/github_repos_${{ matrix.slug }}.jsonl
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
