  collect-candidates:
    name: 4 - Collect candidates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [search-github-keywords, search-github-topics]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Create directories
        run: mkdir -p raw candidates
      - name: Download search artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          pattern: utils-search-*
          path: candidates
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Normalize candidates
        run: |
          python <<'PY'
          import os, json, glob
          files = glob.glob("candidates/**/*.jsonl", recursive=True) + glob.glob("raw/**/*.jsonl", recursive=True)
          out_path = "raw/utils_candidates.jsonl"
          seen = {}
          total = 0
          for fp in sorted(files):
              try:
                  with open(fp, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                      for line in f:
                          line = line.strip()
                          if not line: continue
                          total += 1
                          try: obj = json.loads(line)
                          except: continue
                          repo = obj.get("repo")
                          if not repo: continue
                          if repo not in seen:
                              seen[repo] = obj
                          else:
                              old = seen[repo]
                              old_slugs = old.get("query_slugs", [])
                              if old.get("query_slug") and old["query_slug"] not in old_slugs:
                                  old_slugs.append(old["query_slug"])
                              new_slug = obj.get("query_slug")
                              if new_slug and new_slug not in old_slugs:
                                  old_slugs.append(new_slug)
                              old["query_slugs"] = old_slugs
                              if obj.get("stars", 0) > old.get("stars", 0):
                                  old["stars"] = obj.get("stars", 0)
                              if len(obj.get("description") or "") > len(old.get("description") or ""):
                                  old["description"] = obj.get("description")
                              old_topics = set(old.get("topics") or [])
                              new_topics = set(obj.get("topics") or [])
                              old["topics"] = list(old_topics | new_topics)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"[!] Error reading {fp}: {e}")
          candidates = list(seen.values())
          candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("stars", 0), reverse=True)
          os.makedirs("raw", exist_ok=True)
          with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
              for item in candidates:
                  out.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
          print(f"[*] Total: {total}")
          print(f"[+] Unique: {len(candidates)}")
          PY
      - name: Upload candidates
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: utils-candidates
          path: raw/utils_candidates.jsonl
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  probe-utilities:
    name: 5 - Probe utilities
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: collect-candidates
    if: ${{ always() }}
    timeout-minutes: 70
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests
      - name: Create directories
        run: mkdir -p raw probed "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
      - name: Download candidates
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: utils-candidates
          path: raw
      - name: Probe utilities
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MAX_PROBE: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_probe || '300' }}
          INCLUDE_README: ${{ github.event.inputs.include_readme != false && '1' || '0' }}
          MIN_STARS: ${{ github.event.inputs.min_stars || '0' }}
        run: |
          python <<'PY'
          import os, re, json, time, random, datetime, requests
          GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"
          TOKEN = os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
          UA = os.getenv("USER_AGENT", "REMAININGCONNECTIONS/1.0")
          MAX_PROBE = int(os.getenv("MAX_PROBE", "300"))
          INCLUDE_README = os.getenv("INCLUDE_README", "1") == "1"
          MIN_STARS = int(os.getenv("MIN_STARS", "0"))
          UTILS_OUTPUT = os.getenv("OUTPUT_FILE", "data/utils_found.json")
          HEADERS = {"Accept":"application/vnd.github+json","User-Agent":UA}
          if TOKEN:
              HEADERS["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"
          session = requests.Session()
          session.headers.update(HEADERS)
          ANDROID_KEYS = ["android",".apk",".aab","apk","play google","f-droid","fdroid","android app","android client"]
          IOS_KEYS = ["ios","iphone","ipad",".ipa","ipa","testflight","app store","ios app","ios client"]
          WINDOWS_KEYS = ["windows","win64","win32","win-arm",".exe",".msi",".msix",".appx","portable.exe","windows app"]
          LINUX_KEYS = ["linux","ubuntu","debian","fedora","archlinux","arch linux","appimage",".deb",".rpm",".snap",".flatpak",".pkg.tar.zst",".tar.gz",".tar.xz",".tar.zst",".tar.bz2","linux app"]
          def now_iso():
              return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00","Z")
          def parse_date(v):
              if not v: return None
              try:
                  v = v.replace("Z","+00:00")
                  dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(v)
                  if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
                  return dt
              except: return None
          def days_since(dt):
              if not dt: return None
              return int((datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - dt).total_seconds() / 86400)
          def fetch_json(url, params=None):
              for attempt in range(3):
                  try:
                      r = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=25)
                      if r.status_code == 200: return r.json()
                      if r.status_code == 404: return None
                      if r.status_code in (403,429):
                          ra = r.headers.get("Retry-After")
                          wait = int(ra) if ra and ra.isdigit() else 6
                          time.sleep(wait); continue
                      if 500 <= r.status_code < 600:
                          time.sleep(2+attempt); continue
                      return None
                  except Exception:
                      time.sleep(2+attempt)
              return None
          def fetch_text(url, accept=None):
              try:
                  headers = {}
                  if accept: headers["Accept"] = accept
                  r = session.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=25)
                  if r.status_code == 200 and r.text: return r.text
                  return None
              except Exception:
                  return None
          def detect_from_text(text, flags):
              if not text: return flags
              low = text.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ANDROID_KEYS): flags["android"] = True
              if any(x in low for x in IOS_KEYS): flags["ios"] = True
              if any(x in low for x in WINDOWS_KEYS): flags["windows"] = True
              if any(x in low for x in LINUX_KEYS): flags["linux"] = True
              return flags
          def detect_from_asset_name(name):
              flags = {"android":False,"ios":False,"windows":False,"linux":False}
              if not name: return flags
              n = name.lower()
              if n.endswith((".apk",".aab")) or "android" in n: flags["android"] = True
              if n.endswith(".ipa") or "ios" in n or "iphone" in n or "ipad" in n: flags["ios"] = True
              if n.endswith((".exe",".msi",".msix",".appx")) or "windows" in n or ("win" in n and ("64" in n or "32" in n or "arm" in n)): flags["windows"] = True
              if n.endswith((".appimage",".deb",".rpm",".snap",".flatpak",".pkg.tar.zst")) or "linux" in n: flags["linux"] = True
              return flags
          def merge_flags(target, source):
              for key in target:
                  if source.get(key): target[key] = True
              return target
          def platform_labels(flags):
              labels = []
              if flags.get("android"): labels.append("Android")
              if flags.get("ios"): labels.append("iOS")
              if flags.get("windows"): labels.append("Windows")
              if flags.get("linux"): labels.append("Linux")
              return labels
          def make_status(release_age_days, pushed_at):
              if release_age_days is None:
                  pushed_days = days_since(parse_date(pushed_at))
                  if pushed_days is not None and pushed_days <= 90: return "no_release_recent_repo"
                  return "no_release"
              if release_age_days <= 365: return "active"
              if release_age_days <= 730: return "stale"
              return "outdated"
          def calculate_score(stars, flags, release_age_days, has_release):
              platforms_count = sum(1 for x in flags.values() if x)
              score = stars + platforms_count * 2500
              if has_release and release_age_days is not None:
                  score += max(0, 6000 - release_age_days * 8)
              return int(score)
          cands = []
          if os.path.exists("raw/utils_candidates.jsonl"):
              with open("raw/utils_candidates.jsonl","r",encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  for line in f:
                      line=line.strip()
                      if not line: continue
                      try: cands.append(json.loads(line))
                      except: continue
          print(f"[*] Candidates: {len(cands)}")
          if MIN_STARS > 0:
              cands = [c for c in cands if c.get("stars",0) >= MIN_STARS]
              print(f"[*] After stars filter (>= {MIN_STARS}): {len(cands)}")
          cands.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("stars",0), reverse=True)
          utilities = []
          for idx, c in enumerate(cands[:MAX_PROBE], 1):
              repo = c.get("repo")
              if not repo: continue
              print(f"[*] {idx}/{min(len(cands),MAX_PROBE)}: {repo}")
              rd = fetch_json(f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/{repo}")
              if not rd:
                  time.sleep(1); continue
              full_name = rd.get("full_name", repo)
              html_url = rd.get("html_url", c.get("url"))
              name = rd.get("name", c.get("name", full_name.split("/")[-1]))
              description = rd.get("description") or c.get("description")
              language = rd.get("language")
              topics = rd.get("topics") or c.get("topics") or []
              stars = rd.get("stargazers_count", c.get("stars",0))
              forks = rd.get("forks_count", c.get("forks",0))
              pushed_at = rd.get("pushed_at")
              archived = rd.get("archived", False)
              flags = {"android":False,"ios":False,"windows":False,"linux":False}
              detect_from_text(" ".join(topics), flags)
              detect_from_text(name, flags)
              detect_from_text(description, flags)
              release = fetch_json(f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/{repo}/releases/latest")
              if not release:
                  rels = fetch_json(f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/{repo}/releases", params={"per_page":1})
                  if isinstance(rels, list) and rels: release = rels[0]
              has_release=False; tag=None; rname=None; rurl=None; rpub=None; rage=None; rassets=[]
              if release:
                  has_release=True
                  tag = release.get("tag_name")
                  rname = release.get("name") or release.get("tag_name")
                  rurl = release.get("html_url")
                  rpub = release.get("published_at") or release.get("created_at")
                  rage = days_since(parse_date(rpub))
                  for asset in (release.get("assets",[]) or [])[:20]:
                      an = asset.get("name"); au = asset.get("browser_download_url")
                      if not an or not au: continue
                      af = detect_from_asset_name(an)
                      merge_flags(flags, af)
                      rassets.append({"name":an,"url":au,"size_mb":round((asset.get("size") or 0)/(1024*1024),2),"content_type":asset.get("content_type"),"platform_hint":platform_labels(af)})
              if INCLUDE_README and (not any(flags.values()) or not has_release):
                  rt = fetch_text(f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/{repo}/readme", accept="application/vnd.github.raw")
                  if rt: detect_from_text(rt[:80000], flags)
              labels = platform_labels(flags)
              status = make_status(rage, pushed_at)
              score = calculate_score(stars, flags, rage, has_release)
              utilities.append({"id":idx,"name":name,"full_name":full_name,"url":html_url,"description":description,"language":language,"topics":topics,"stars":stars,"forks":forks,"archived":archived,"pushed_at":pushed_at,"query_slugs":c.get("query_slugs",[]),"has_release":has_release,"latest_release_tag":tag,"latest_release_name":rname,"latest_release_url":rurl,"latest_release_published_at":rpub,"release_age_days":rage,"platforms":flags,"platform_labels":labels,"platforms_text":", ".join(labels) if labels else "Unknown","release_assets_count":len(rassets),"release_assets":rassets[:12],"status":status,"score":score})
              time.sleep(random.uniform(0.35, 1.1))
          utilities.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
          for idx, item in enumerate(utilities, 1):
              item["id"] = idx
          summary = {
              "total_utilities": len(utilities),
              "with_release": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["has_release"]),
              "without_release": sum(1 for x in utilities if not x["has_release"]),
              "android": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["android"]),
              "ios": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["ios"]),
              "windows": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["windows"]),
              "linux": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["linux"]),
              "active": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["status"]=="active"),
              "stale": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["status"]=="stale"),
              "outdated": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["status"]=="outdated"),
              "no_release": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["status"]=="no_release"),
              "no_release_recent_repo": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["status"]=="no_release_recent_repo"),
          }
          payload = {"generated_at":now_iso(),"generator":"utils-discovery.yml","project":"REMAININGCONNECTIONS dashboard","telegram_channel":"https://t.me/REMAININGCONNECTIONS","candidates_checked":len(utilities),"summary":summary,"utilities":utilities}
          os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(UTILS_OUTPUT), exist_ok=True)
          with open("probed/utils_probed.json","w",encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
          with open(UTILS_OUTPUT,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
          print(f"Utilities: {summary['total_utilities']}")
          print(f"With release: {summary['with_release']}")
          print(f"Android: {summary['android']}")
          print(f"iOS: {summary['ios']}")
          print(f"Windows: {summary['windows']}")
          print(f"Linux: {summary['linux']}")
          PY
      - name: Upload utility results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: utils-results
          path: |
            probed/utils_probed.json
            data/utils_found.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  publish-results:
    name: 6 - Publish results
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: probe-utilities
    if: ${{ always() && needs.probe-utilities.result == 'success' && github.event.inputs.dry_run != true }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Create directories
        run: mkdir -p data downloaded
      - name: Download utility results
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: utils-results
          path: downloaded
      - name: Move result into data directory
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          FOUND_FILE="$(find downloaded -type f -name 'utils_found.json' | head -n 1 || true)"
          if [[ -z "${FOUND_FILE}" ]]; then
            echo "[!] Not found, creating placeholder"
            cat > data/utils_found.json <<'JSON'
          {"generated_at":"","generator":"utils-discovery.yml","candidates_checked":0,"summary":{"total_utilities":0,"with_release":0,"without_release":0,"android":0,"ios":0,"windows":0,"linux":0,"active":0,"stale":0,"outdated":0,"no_release":0,"no_release_recent_repo":0},"utilities":[]}
          JSON
          else
            cp "${FOUND_FILE}" data/utils_found.json
            echo "[+] File copied"
          fi
      - name: Commit and push data
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git pull --rebase origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" || true
          git add data/utils_found.json || true
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "[*] No changes"
          else
            git commit -m "chore(data): update utils_found.json [skip ci]"
            git push origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
            echo "[+] Committed"
          fi

  report:
    name: 7 - Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [collect-candidates, probe-utilities, publish-results]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Download utility results for report
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: utils-results
          path: utils-report-artifacts
      - name: Print report
        run: |
          echo "=================================================="
          echo " Utility Discovery Pipeline finished"
          echo "=================================================="
          FILE="$(find utils-report-artifacts -type f -name 'utils_found.json' | head -n 1 || true)"
          if [[ -z "${FILE}" ]]; then
            echo "[!] No results file"
            exit 0
          fi
          python <<PY
          import json
          path = "${FILE}"
          try:
              with open(path,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  data = json.load(f)
              summary = data.get("summary",{})
              utilities = data.get("utilities",[])
              print(f"Generated: {data.get('generated_at')}")
              print(f"Utilities: {summary.get('total_utilities')}")
              print(f"With release: {summary.get('with_release')}")
              print(f"Android: {summary.get('android')}")
              print(f"iOS: {summary.get('ios')}")
              print(f"Windows: {summary.get('windows')}")
              print(f"Linux: {summary.get('linux')}")
              print(f"Active: {summary.get('active')}")
              print("\nTop-10 by score:")
              for item in utilities[:10]:
                  print(f"  - {item.get('name')} | stars: {item.get('stars')} | {item.get('platforms_text')} | release: {item.get('latest_release_tag') or 'none'}")
          except Exception as e:
              print(f"[!] Report error: {e}")
          PY
          echo "=================================================="

## About the project

**REMAININGCONNECTIONS** is an automated monitoring system for censorship-circumvention tools and connection-quality checks.

It works autonomously, without human intervention:

- **Finds** subscriptions (VLESS, VMESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard) on GitHub and Gitverse
- **Collects** working Telegram MTProto proxies
- **Detects** verified Open Source utilities and clients for all platforms
- **Validates** freshness: last commit, number of configs, BS/CS status, ping
- **Measures** internet speed right in the browser - download, upload, ping, jitter
- **Displays** everything on a live dashboard with filters, search and sorting

---

## Speed Test

The built-in internet speed test runs entirely in the browser, with no server-side component:

- **Ping (RTT)** - via `fetch` to a small file, multiple samples
- **Jitter** - ping variation between requests
- **Download** - through a large payload fetch, Mbit/s calculation
- **Upload** - via `XMLHttpRequest` with real-time progress tracking (fixed in 2024)
- **Progress** - animated speedometers and a live measurement log

Open the **Speed Test** tab on the dashboard and press **Start**.

### 🔧 Speed Test Upload Fix Applied
The upload measurement now uses `XMLHttpRequest` instead of `fetch()` API to accurately track data transmission progress. This provides:
- ✅ Real upload speed (not instant completion)
- ✅ Animated speedometer during upload
- ✅ Progress logs with intermediate values
- ✅ Accurate Mbps calculation

See `SPEED_TEST_FIX.md` for technical details.

---

## About the developer

The project is built by a **single person** - a solo developer.

All code, parsers, dashboard, automation and design are done manually, without a team or budget.

---

## How it works

```
GitHub / Gitverse / Telegram
            |
            v
   GitHub Actions (parsers)
            |  every 1 hour ⚡ NEW
            v
      data/*.json (data)
            |
            v
   docs/index.html (dashboard)
            |
            v
      GitHub Pages (site)
            |
            v
   User + Speed Test
```

---

## Structure

```
REMAININGCONNECTIONS/
|-- docs/
|   |-- index.html        <- dashboard + Speed Test
|   |-- speedtest-fix.js  <- upload fix (NEW)
|-- data/                 <- parser data (JSON)
|-- scripts/              <- Python generators
|-- .github/workflows/    <- automation (Actions)
|-- SPEED_TEST_FIX.md     <- upload fix documentation (NEW)
|-- FIXES_SUMMARY.md      <- complete changelog (NEW)
```

---

## Automation

| Workflow | What it does | Schedule | Status |
|----------|--------------|----------|--------|
| Subscription Discovery | Search and validate subscriptions | **every hour** ⚡ | ✅ Updated |
| TG Proxy Discovery | Search and ping TG proxies | every hour | ✅ Active |
| Utils Discovery | Search utilities (Android/iOS/Windows/Linux) | **every hour** ⚡ | ✅ Updated |
| Search Query Generator | Auto-generate search queries | **every hour** ⚡ | ✅ Updated |
| Enterprise Deploy | Build and deploy to GitHub Pages | on push to main | ✅ Active |
| Export & Validate YAML | Export codebase.txt + YAML check | daily | ✅ Active |

⚡ = Updated to run more frequently (was: 2-6 hours)

### ⚠️ GitHub Actions Usage Note
With all workflows running every hour, the monthly usage will be approximately **18,000-72,000 minutes** depending on execution time. The free GitHub tier provides **2,000 minutes/month**. Consider:
- Using a paid GitHub plan ($4/month for 3,000 additional minutes)
- Reducing workflow frequency (e.g., every 2-3 hours)
- Lowering `max_repos` and `max_probe` limits in workflow inputs

See `FIXES_SUMMARY.md` for detailed recommendations.

---

## Tech stack

- **Frontend:** HTML, Tailwind CSS (CDN), vanilla JavaScript (IIFE)
- **Backend / parsers:** Python 3.11 (requests, pyyaml), GitHub Actions
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages (static, free)
- **Data sources:** GitHub API, Gitverse API, raw.githubusercontent.com
- **Speed Test:** native `fetch` + `XMLHttpRequest` + Performance API, no third-party services

## Bypass Blocking

### Option 1: Google Translate Proxy (built-in)
```
https://translate.google.com/translate?sl=en&tl=ru&u=https://b3b3097.github.io/REMAININGCONNECTIONS/
```
⚠️ May be slow or unreliable

### Option 2: Cloudflare Workers (recommended, free)
Deploy a simple proxy worker:
```javascript
addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  event.respondWith(handleRequest(event.request))
})

async function handleRequest(request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const targetUrl = 'https://b3b3097.github.io' + url.pathname
  const response = await fetch(targetUrl)
  return new Response(response.body, response)
}
```
Access via: `https://your-worker.workers.dev`

### Option 3: Custom Domain
1. Buy a cheap domain (~$1/year on Namecheap)
2. GitHub Settings → Pages → Custom domain
3. Free SSL certificate from GitHub

See `FIXES_SUMMARY.md` for detailed instructions.

        (() => {

                refreshBtn: $("refreshBtn"),

                statBsSubs: $("statBsSubs"),

                subsInfo: $("subsInfo"),

                subsLoadMoreWrap: $("subsLoadMoreWrap"),
                subsLoadMoreBtn: $("subsLoadMoreBtn"),
                subsVisibleInfo: $("subsVisibleInfo"),

                proxiesList: $("proxiesList"),
                proxiesLoadMoreWrap: $("proxiesLoadMoreWrap"),
                proxiesLoadMoreBtn: $("proxiesLoadMoreBtn"),
                proxiesVisibleInfo: $("proxiesVisibleInfo"),
                utilsInfo: $("utilsInfo"),
                utilsGrid: $("utilsGrid"),
                utilsLoadMoreWrap: $("utilsLoadMoreWrap"),
                utilsLoadMoreBtn: $("utilsLoadMoreBtn"),
                utilsVisibleInfo: $("utilsVisibleInfo"),
                toastContainer: $("toastContainer"),

                gaugeLabel: $("gaugeLabel"),
                gaugeProgress: $("gaugeProgress"),
                speedPhase: $("speedPhase"),
                speedStartBtn: $("speedStartBtn"),
                speedStopBtn: $("speedStopBtn"),
                speedClearLogBtn: $("speedClearLogBtn"),
                speedLog: $("speedLog"),
                resultPing: $("resultPing"),
                resultJitter: $("resultJitter"),
                resultDownload: $("resultDownload"),
                resultUpload: $("resultUpload")
            };

            const GAUGE_CIRCUMFERENCE = 2 * Math.PI * 96;

            const MOCK_SUBSCRIPTIONS = [
                { id: 1, name: "example-vless-sub", source: "github", url: "#", subscription_url: "#", updated_mins_ago: 12, configs_count: 1240, has_bs: true, status: "active", last_commit_message: "auto: update nodes" },
                { id: 2, name: "example-clash-sub", source: "gitverse", url: "#", subscription_url: "#", updated_mins_ago: 95, configs_count: 320, has_bs: false, status: "unknown", last_commit_message: "chore: refresh list" }
            ];

            const MOCK_PROXIES = [
                { id: 1, host: "185.22.11.44", port: 443, protocol: "MTProto", ping: 52, status: "online", secret: "dd1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef", tg_url: "tg://proxy?server=185.22.11.44&port=443&secret=dd1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef" }
            ];

            const MOCK_UTILITIES = [
                { id: 1, name: "example-client", full_name: "example/example-client", url: "#", stars: 1200, description: "Example proxy client.", platforms: ["Android", "Windows"], latest_release_tag: "1.0.0", release_age_days: 10, status: "active" }
            ];

            function escapeHtml(value) {
                if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
                return String(value).replaceAll("&", "&amp;").replaceAll("<", "&lt;").replaceAll(">", "&gt;").replaceAll('"', "&quot;").replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
            }

            function formatNumber(value) {
                const n = Number(value || 0);
                if (n >= 1_000_000) return (n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "") + "M";
                if (n >= 1_000) return (n / 1_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "") + "k";
                return String(n);
            }

            function formatMinutes(mins) {
                const m = Number(mins);
                if (!Number.isFinite(m)) return "unknown";
                if (m < 1) return "now";
                if (m < 60) return `${Math.floor(m)} min`;
                if (m < 1440) return `${Math.floor(m / 60)} h`;
                if (m < 525600) return `${Math.floor(m / 1440)} d`;
                return `${Math.floor(m / 525600)} y`;
            }

            function showToast(message, type = "info") {
                const colors = { success: "border-l-4 border-emerald-400", error: "border-l-4 border-red-400", info: "border-l-4 border-blue-400" };
                const toast = document.createElement("div");
                toast.className = `toast ${colors[type] || colors.info}`;
                toast.innerHTML = `<div class="text-sm">${escapeHtml(message)}</div>`;
                els.toastContainer.appendChild(toast);
                setTimeout(() => { toast.style.opacity = "0"; toast.style.transform = "translateY(8px)"; setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250); }, 3500);
            }

            async function copyText(text, message) {
                try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); showToast(message || "Copied", "success"); }
                catch (e) { showToast("Copy failed", "error"); }
            }

            document.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
                const target = event.target.closest("[data-copy]");
                if (!target) return;
                const value = target.getAttribute("data-copy");
                if (!value) return;
                await copyText(value, target.dataset.copyMessage || "Copied");
            });

            async function fetchJson(url) {
                const response = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
                return response.json();
            }

            async function fetchFirstAvailable(urls) {
                for (const url of urls) {
                    try { return await fetchJson(url); } catch (e) {}
                }
                return null;
            }

            function normalizeSubscriptions(payload) {
                let items = [];
                if (Array.isArray(payload)) items = payload;
                else if (payload && Array.isArray(payload.subscriptions)) items = payload.subscriptions;
                else if (payload && Array.isArray(payload.items)) items = payload.items;

                return items
                    .map((item, index) => {
                        const source = String(item.source || "github").toLowerCase();
                        return {
                            id: item.id || index + 1,
                            name: item.name || item.repo || "Unknown",
                            source,
                            source_label: source === "gitverse" ? "Gitverse" : "GitHub",
                            url: item.url || item.subscription_url || "#",
                            subscription_url: item.subscription_url || item.url || "",
                            updated_mins_ago: item.updated_mins_ago ?? item.updated_minutes_ago ?? null,
                            configs_count: Number(item.configs_count ?? item.configs ?? 0),
                            has_bs: Boolean(item.has_bs ?? item.bs ?? false),
                            status: item.status || "unknown",
                            last_commit_message: item.last_commit_message || item.last_commit || ""
                        };
                    })
                    .filter(item => item.configs_count > 0 && item.subscription_url && item.subscription_url !== "#");
            }

            function normalizeProxies(payload) {
                let items = [];
                if (Array.isArray(payload)) items = payload;
                else if (payload && Array.isArray(payload.proxies)) items = payload.proxies;
                return items.map((item, index) => {
                    const host = item.host || item.server || "unknown";
                    const port = item.port || 443;
                    const secret = item.secret || "";
                    return {
                        id: item.id || index + 1, host, port,
                        protocol: item.protocol || "MTProto",
                        ping: item.latency_ms ?? item.ping ?? null,
                        status: item.status || "offline",
                        secret,
                        secret_type: item.secret_type || "",
                        tg_url: item.tg_url || `tg://proxy?server=${encodeURIComponent(host)}&port=${encodeURIComponent(port)}&secret=${encodeURIComponent(secret)}`,
                        tme_url: item.tme_url || `https://t.me/proxy?server=${encodeURIComponent(host)}&port=${encodeURIComponent(port)}&secret=${encodeURIComponent(secret)}`
                    };
                });
            }

            function normalizeUtilities(payload) {
                let items = [];
                if (Array.isArray(payload)) items = payload;
                else if (payload && Array.isArray(payload.utilities)) items = payload.utilities;
                return items.map((item, index) => {
                    let platforms = [];
                    if (Array.isArray(item.platform_labels)) platforms = item.platform_labels;
                    else if (typeof item.platforms_text === "string" && item.platforms_text.trim()) platforms = item.platforms_text.split(",").map(x => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                    return {
                        id: item.id || index + 1,
                        name: item.name || "Unknown",
                        full_name: item.full_name || item.repo || item.name || "Unknown",
                        url: item.url || "#",
                        stars: Number(item.stars || 0),
                        description: item.description || "",
                        platforms,
                        latest_release_tag: item.latest_release_tag || null,
                        latest_release_url: item.latest_release_url || item.url || "#",
                        release_age_days: item.release_age_days ?? null,
                        status: item.status || "unknown"
                    };
                });
            }

            function buildActivity(subsPayload, proxiesPayload, utilsPayload, cleanupPayload) {
                const activity = [];
                if (cleanupPayload) activity.push({ time: cleanupPayload.cleaned_at || cleanupPayload.generated_at || "", text: `Subscriptions cleanup: removed ${cleanupPayload.removed ?? cleanupPayload.dead ?? 0}, remaining ${cleanupPayload.total_after ?? cleanupPayload.alive ?? 0}.`, type: "success" });
                if (subsPayload && subsPayload.generated_at) activity.push({ time: subsPayload.generated_at, text: `Subscription data updated by parser.`, type: "info" });
                if (proxiesPayload && proxiesPayload.generated_at) activity.push({ time: proxiesPayload.generated_at, text: `TG proxy check finished: online ${proxiesPayload.online_count ?? 0} of ${proxiesPayload.checked_count ?? 0}.`, type: "info" });
                if (utilsPayload && utilsPayload.generated_at) activity.push({ time: utilsPayload.generated_at, text: `Utilities database updated: found ${utilsPayload.summary?.total_utilities ?? utilsPayload.utilities?.length ?? 0}.`, type: "info" });
                if (!activity.length) activity.push({ time: new Date().toISOString(), text: "No data found, using demo data.", type: "warning" });
                return activity.slice(0, 12);
            }

            function getFilteredSubscriptions() {
                let items = [...state.subscriptions];
                const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (q) items = items.filter(item => String(item.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(item.url || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(item.subscription_url || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(item.last_commit_message || "").toLowerCase().includes(q));
                if (state.source !== "all") items = items.filter(item => item.source === state.source);
                if (state.status === "bs") items = items.filter(item => item.has_bs);
                if (state.status === "cs") items = items.filter(item => !item.has_bs);
                if (["active", "stale", "unknown", "dead", "error"].includes(state.status)) items = items.filter(item => item.status === state.status);
                if (state.sort === "updated") items.sort((a, b) => (a.updated_mins_ago ?? 999999999) - (b.updated_mins_ago ?? 999999999));
                if (state.sort === "configs") items.sort((a, b) => (b.configs_count || 0) - (a.configs_count || 0));
                if (state.sort === "name") items.sort((a, b) => String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), "en"));
                return items;
            }

            function getFilteredProxies() {
                let items = [...state.proxies];
                const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (q) items = items.filter(item => String(item.host || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(item.secret || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(item.protocol || "").toLowerCase().includes(q));
                if (state.status === "online") items = items.filter(item => item.status === "online");
                if (state.status === "offline") items = items.filter(item => item.status !== "online");
                if (state.sort === "ping") items.sort((a, b) => (a.ping ?? 999999) - (b.ping ?? 999999));
                else items.sort((a, b) => { const oA = a.status === "online" ? 0 : 1; const oB = b.status === "online" ? 0 : 1; if (oA !== oB) return oA - oB; return (a.ping ?? 999999) - (b.ping ?? 999999); });
                return items;
            }

            function getFilteredUtilities() {
                let items = [...state.utilities];
                const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (q) items = items.filter(item => String(item.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(item.full_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(item.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.platforms.some(p => p.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
                if (["active", "stale", "outdated", "no_release"].includes(state.status)) items = items.filter(item => item.status === state.status);
                if (state.sort === "stars") items.sort((a, b) => (b.stars || 0) - (a.stars || 0));
                else if (state.sort === "name") items.sort((a, b) => String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name), "en"));
                else items.sort((a, b) => (b.stars || 0) - (a.stars || 0));
                return items;
            }

            function renderDashboard() {
                const totalSubs = state.subscriptions.length;
                const totalConfigs = state.subscriptions.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.configs_count || 0), 0);
                const activeSubs = state.subscriptions.filter(item => item.status === "active").length;
                const bsSubs = state.subscriptions.filter(item => item.has_bs).length;
                const onlineProxies = state.proxies.filter(item => item.status === "online").length;
                const totalUtils = state.utilities.length;
                els.statTotalSubs.textContent = formatNumber(totalSubs);
                els.statTotalConfigs.textContent = formatNumber(totalConfigs);
                els.statActiveSubs.textContent = formatNumber(activeSubs);
                els.statBsSubs.textContent = formatNumber(bsSubs);
                els.statOnlineProxies.textContent = formatNumber(onlineProxies);
                els.statUtilities.textContent = formatNumber(totalUtils);
                els.activityFeed.innerHTML = state.activity.map(item => {
                    const color = item.type === "success" ? "bg-emerald-400" : item.type === "warning" ? "bg-yellow-400" : item.type === "error" ? "bg-red-400" : "bg-blue-400";
                    return `<div class="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-3"><span class="mt-1 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ${color}"></span><div class="min-w-0"><div class="text-sm leading-6">${escapeHtml(item.text)}</div><div class="text-xs text-faint mt-1">${escapeHtml(item.time || "")}</div></div></div>`;
                }).join("") || `<div class="text-sm text-faint">No activity.</div>`;
                const top = [...state.subscriptions].sort((a, b) => (a.updated_mins_ago ?? 999999999) - (b.updated_mins_ago ?? 999999999)).slice(0, 8);
                els.topSubsPreview.innerHTML = top.map(item => {
                    const bs = item.has_bs ? `<span class="badge badge-bs">BS</span>` : `<span class="badge badge-cs">CS</span>`;
                    return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-3"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="font-bold truncate">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</div><div class="text-xs text-faint mt-1">${escapeHtml(item.source_label)} | configs: ${formatNumber(item.configs_count)} | ${formatMinutes(item.updated_mins_ago)}</div></div>${bs}</div>`;
                }).join("") || `<div class="text-sm text-faint">No subscriptions found.</div>`;
            }

            function subCard(item) {
                const sourceBadge = item.source === "gitverse" ? `<span class="badge badge-gitverse">Gitverse</span>` : `<span class="badge badge-github">GitHub</span>`;
                const bsBadge = item.has_bs ? `<span class="badge badge-bs">BS</span>` : `<span class="badge badge-cs">CS</span>`;
                const statusColor = item.status === "active" ? "text-emerald-300" : item.status === "stale" ? "text-yellow-300" : item.status === "dead" || item.status === "error" ? "text-red-300" : "text-slate-300";
                const updatedColor = (item.updated_mins_ago ?? 999999) > 43200 ? "text-red-300" : "text-emerald-300";
                return `<article class="card p-5"><div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3"><div class="min-w-0"><h3 class="font-black text-lg truncate" title="${escapeHtml(item.name)}">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</h3><div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mt-2">${sourceBadge}<span class="badge badge-neutral ${statusColor}">${escapeHtml(item.status || "unknown")}</span></div></div>${bsBadge}</div><div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-4"><div class="rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-3"><div class="text-xs text-faint font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Configs</div><div class="text-2xl font-black mt-1">${formatNumber(item.configs_count)}</div></div><div class="rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-3"><div class="text-xs text-faint font-bold uppercase tracking-widest">Updated</div><div class="text-2xl font-black mt-1 ${updatedColor}">${formatMinutes(item.updated_mins_ago)}</div></div></div><div class="text-xs text-faint mt-4 truncate">Last commit: ${escapeHtml(item.last_commit_message || "n/a")}</div><div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-5"><a href="${escapeHtml(item.url || "#")}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary w-full">Source</a><button class="btn btn-secondary w-full" data-copy="${escapeHtml(item.subscription_url || item.url || "")}" data-copy-message="Subscription link copied">Copy</button></div></article>`;

            function proxyCard(item) {

            async function loadData() {

            }

            const SPEED = {
                downloadUrl: "https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=",
                uploadUrl: "https://speed.cloudflare.com/__up",
                pingUrl: "https://speed.cloudflare.com/__down?bytes=0",
                maxDownloadBytes: 25 * 1024 * 1024,
                maxUploadBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
                pingSamples: 8,
                downloadDurationMs: 12000,
                uploadDurationMs: 10000
            };

            function setGauge(mbps, label) {
                const v = Math.max(0, Number(mbps) || 0);
                els.gaugeValue.textContent = v.toFixed(2);
                const visual = Math.min(v, 150) / 150;
                const offset = GAUGE_CIRCUMFERENCE * (1 - visual);
                els.gaugeProgress.style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
                if (label) els.gaugeLabel.textContent = label;
            }

            function speedLog(text, value = "") {
                const line = document.createElement("div");
                line.className = "speed-log-line";
                line.innerHTML = `<span>${escapeHtml(text)}</span><span class="text-faint">${escapeHtml(value)}</span>`;
                if (els.speedLog.children.length === 1) { const first = els.speedLog.firstElementChild; if (first && first.textContent.includes("Log is empty")) first.remove(); }
                els.speedLog.appendChild(line);
                els.speedLog.scrollTop = els.speedLog.scrollHeight;
            }

            function clearSpeedLog() { els.speedLog.innerHTML = `<div class="speed-log-line text-faint"><span>Log is empty. Start a test.</span></div>`; }

            function formatMbps(bytesPerSec) { return (bytesPerSec * 8) / 1_000_000; }

            async function measurePing() {
                els.speedPhase.textContent = "Measuring ping...";
                setGauge(0, "ping");
                const samples = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < SPEED.pingSamples; i++) {
                    if (state.speedAbort) return null;
                    const t0 = performance.now();
                    try { await fetch(SPEED.pingUrl + "&_=" + Date.now() + "-" + i, { cache: "no-store", mode: "cors" }); const t1 = performance.now(); const rtt = t1 - t0; samples.push(rtt); setGauge(rtt, "ping"); speedLog(`ping #${i + 1}`, `${rtt.toFixed(1)} ms`); }
                    catch (e) { speedLog(`ping #${i + 1}`, "error"); }
                }
                if (!samples.length) return { ping: null, jitter: null };
                samples.sort((a, b) => a - b);
                const trimmed = samples.length > 4 ? samples.slice(1, -1) : samples;
                const ping = trimmed.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / trimmed.length;
                let jitter = 0;
                for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) jitter += Math.abs(samples[i] - samples[i - 1]);
                jitter = samples.length > 1 ? jitter / (samples.length - 1) : 0;
                return { ping, jitter };
            }

            async function measureDownload() {
                els.speedPhase.textContent = "Measuring download...";
                setGauge(0, "download");
                const url = SPEED.downloadUrl;
                const start = performance.now();
                let received = 0, lastReport = start, lastReceived = 0;
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(url + SPEED.maxDownloadBytes + "&_=" + Date.now(), { cache: "no-store", mode: "cors" });
                    if (!response.body) throw new Error("no response body");
                    const reader = response.body.getReader();
                    while (true) {
                        if (state.speedAbort) break;
                        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
                        if (done) break;
                        if (value) received += value.length;
                        const now = performance.now();
                        const elapsed = now - start;
                        if (now - lastReport > 200) { const inst = (received - lastReceived) / ((now - lastReport) / 1000); const m = formatMbps(inst); setGauge(m, "download"); speedLog(`download ${Math.round(received / 1024)} KB`, `${m.toFixed(2)} Mbps`); lastReport = now; lastReceived = received; }
                        if (elapsed > SPEED.downloadDurationMs) break;
                    }
                    try { await reader.cancel(); } catch (e) {}
                    const totalElapsed = (performance.now() - start) / 1000;
                    if (totalElapsed <= 0 || received <= 0) return null;
                    return formatMbps(received / totalElapsed);
                } catch (e) { speedLog("download", "error: " + (e.message || "")); return null; }
            }

            async function measureUpload() {
                els.speedPhase.textContent = "Measuring upload...";
                setGauge(0, "upload");
                const chunkSize = 256 * 1024;
                const chunk = new Uint8Array(chunkSize);
                crypto.getRandomValues(chunk);
                const totalChunks = Math.floor(SPEED.maxUploadBytes / chunkSize);
                const parts = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < totalChunks; i++) parts.push(chunk);
                const bigPayload = new Blob(parts);
                const start = performance.now();
                try {
                    const response = await fetch(SPEED.uploadUrl, { method: "POST", body: bigPayload, mode: "cors", cache: "no-store" });
                    const elapsed = (performance.now() - start) / 1000;
                    const bytes = bigPayload.size;
                    if (!response.ok && response.status !== 0) speedLog(`upload ${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`, `HTTP ${response.status}`);
                    if (elapsed <= 0 || bytes <= 0) return null;
                    const mbps = formatMbps(bytes / elapsed);
                    setGauge(mbps, "upload");
                    speedLog(`upload ${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`, `${mbps.toFixed(2)} Mbps`);
                    return mbps;
                } catch (e) { speedLog("upload", "error: " + (e.message || "")); return null; }
            }

            async function runSpeedTest() {
                if (state.speedRunning) return;
                state.speedRunning = true;
                state.speedAbort = false;
                els.speedStartBtn.classList.add("hidden");
                els.speedStopBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
                els.speedStartBtn.disabled = true;
                els.resultPing.textContent = "--"; els.resultJitter.textContent = "--"; els.resultDownload.textContent = "--"; els.resultUpload.textContent = "--";
                speedLog("=== Test started ===", new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
                const pingResult = await measurePing();
                if (pingResult) { els.resultPing.textContent = pingResult.ping != null ? pingResult.ping.toFixed(1) : "--"; els.resultJitter.textContent = pingResult.jitter != null ? pingResult.jitter.toFixed(1) : "--"; speedLog("Ping", pingResult.ping != null ? `${pingResult.ping.toFixed(1)} ms` : "n/a"); speedLog("Jitter", pingResult.jitter != null ? `${pingResult.jitter.toFixed(1)} ms` : "n/a"); }
                const dl = await measureDownload();
                els.resultDownload.textContent = dl != null ? dl.toFixed(2) : "--";
                const ul = await measureUpload();
                els.resultUpload.textContent = ul != null ? ul.toFixed(2) : "--";
                const finalVal = dl != null ? dl : 0;
                setGauge(finalVal, "done");
                els.speedPhase.textContent = "Test finished";
                speedLog("=== Test finished ===", "");
                state.speedRunning = false;
                els.speedStartBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
                els.speedStopBtn.classList.add("hidden");
                els.speedStartBtn.disabled = false;
                showToast("Speed test finished", "success");
            }

            function stopSpeedTest() { state.speedAbort = true; els.speedPhase.textContent = "Stopping..."; speedLog("Test aborted by user", ""); }

            els.tabButtons.forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener("click", () => {
                    state.tab = button.dataset.tab;
                    els.tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active"));
                    button.classList.add("active");
                    els.tabContents.forEach(content => content.classList.add("hidden"));
                    const target = $(`tab-${state.tab}`);
                    if (target) target.classList.remove("hidden");
                    els.filtersBar.classList.toggle("hidden", state.tab === "speedtest");
                    renderCurrentTab(true);
                });
            });

            let searchTimer = null;
            els.searchInput.addEventListener("input", () => { clearTimeout(searchTimer); searchTimer = setTimeout(() => { state.search = els.searchInput.value; renderCurrentTab(true); }, 180); });
            els.sourceFilter.addEventListener("change", () => { state.source = els.sourceFilter.value; renderCurrentTab(true); });
            els.statusFilter.addEventListener("change", () => { state.status = els.statusFilter.value; renderCurrentTab(true); });
            els.sortFilter.addEventListener("change", () => { state.sort = els.sortFilter.value; renderCurrentTab(true); });
            els.refreshBtn.addEventListener("click", loadData);
            els.subsLoadMoreBtn.addEventListener("click", () => renderSubscriptions(false));
            els.proxiesLoadMoreBtn.addEventListener("click", () => renderProxies(false));
            els.utilsLoadMoreBtn.addEventListener("click", () => renderUtilities(false));
            els.speedStartBtn.addEventListener("click", runSpeedTest);
            els.speedStopBtn.addEventListener("click", stopSpeedTest);
            els.speedClearLogBtn.addEventListener("click", clearSpeedLog);

            window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
                if (state.loading) return;
                const nearBottom = window.innerHeight + window.scrollY >= document.body.offsetHeight - 900;
                if (!nearBottom) return;
                if (state.tab === "subscriptions" && state.subsVisible < state.lastCounts.subscriptions) renderSubscriptions(false);
                if (state.tab === "proxies" && state.proxiesVisible < state.lastCounts.proxies) renderProxies(false);
                if (state.tab === "utilities" && state.utilsVisible < state.lastCounts.utilities) renderUtilities(false);
            });

            if (location.hash === "#tab-speedtest") { const btn = document.querySelector('.tab-btn[data-tab="speedtest"]'); if (btn) btn.click(); }

            loadData();
        })();
    </script>

/*
 * configs.js — self-contained module for REMAININGCONNECTIONS dashboard.
 * Adds: "Show configs" button on subscription cards, configs modal with
 * QR codes + copy + client deep-links, and browser-side ping for proxies.
 * No external dependencies; injects its own CSS and modal HTML.
 */
(() => {
  "use strict";

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const PROTO_RE = /^(vless|vmess|trojan|ss|ssr|hysteria2?|hy2|tuic|wireguard|socks5?|https?):\/\//i;
  const QR_API = "https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=180x180&data=";

  // CORS proxies as fallback when direct fetch fails
  const CORS_PROXIES = [
    (u) => `https://corsproxy.io/?url=${encodeURIComponent(u)}`,
    (u) => `https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=${encodeURIComponent(u)}`,
    (u) => `https://cors-anywhere.herokuapp.com/${u}`,
  ];

  const CLIENT_LINKS = {
    clash: (sub, name) => `clash://install-config?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}&name=${encodeURIComponent(name || "sub")}`,
    clashmeta: (sub, name) => `clash://install-sub?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}&name=${encodeURIComponent(name || "sub")}`,
    hiddify: (sub) => `hiddify://subscription?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`,
    singbox: (sub) => `sing-box://import-remote-profile?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`,
    v2rayng: (sub) => `v2rayng://install-sub?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`,
    v2rayn: (sub) => `v2rayn://install-sub?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`,
    nekobox: (sub) => `nekobox://subscription?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`,
    shadowrocket: (sub) => `shadowrocket://add/sub?url=${encodeURIComponent(sub)}`,
  };

  // ---------- Utils ----------
  const esc = (v) => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return "";
    return String(v)
      .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
      .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
      .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
      .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
      .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
  };

  const toast = (msg, type = "info") => {
    const c = document.getElementById("toastContainer");
    if (!c) return;
    const colors = {
      success: "border-l-4 border-emerald-400",
      error: "border-l-4 border-red-400",
      info: "border-l-4 border-blue-400",
    };
    const t = document.createElement("div");
    t.className = `toast ${colors[type] || colors.info}`;
    t.innerHTML = `<div class="text-sm">${esc(msg)}</div>`;
    c.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(() => {
      t.style.opacity = "0";
      t.style.transform = "translateY(8px)";
      setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 250);
    }, 3000);
  };

  const copyText = async (text, msg) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      toast(msg || "Copied", "success");
    } catch (e) {
      // fallback
      const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.value = text;
      ta.style.position = "fixed";
      ta.style.opacity = "0";
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      try { document.execCommand("copy"); toast(msg || "Copied", "success"); } catch (e2) { toast("Copy failed", "error"); }
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }
  };

  const decodeBase64 = (s) => {
    try {
      const cleaned = s.replace(/\s/g, "").replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
      const pad = cleaned + "=".repeat((4 - (cleaned.length % 4)) % 4);
      const bin = atob(pad);
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
      return new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(bytes);
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const parseNameFromConfig = (line) => {
    const m = line.match(/#([^#]*)$/);
    if (m) {
      try { return decodeURIComponent(m[1]).trim(); } catch (e) { return m[1].trim(); }
    }
    if (line.startsWith("vmess://")) {
      const payload = line.slice("vmess://".length);
      const json = decodeBase64(payload);
      if (json) {
        try {
          const obj = JSON.parse(json);
          if (obj && obj.ps) return obj.ps;
          if (obj && obj.add) return `${obj.add}:${obj.port || ""}`;
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
    return null;
  };

  const parseSubscription = (text) => {
    if (!text) return [];
    let working = text;
    const hasProto = PROTO_RE.test(working);
    if (!hasProto && working.length > 20) {
      const decoded = decodeBase64(working);
      if (decoded && PROTO_RE.test(decoded)) {
        working = decoded;
      }
    }
    const lines = working
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .map((l) => l.trim())
      .filter((l) => l && PROTO_RE.test(l));
    return lines.map((line, i) => {
      const proto = (line.match(PROTO_RE) || [])[1] || "unknown";
      const name = parseNameFromConfig(line) || `${proto} #${i + 1}`;
      return { proto: proto.toLowerCase(), raw: line, name };
    });
  };

  const fetchSubscription = async (url) => {
    // Try direct fetch first
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
      if (res.ok) {
        const text = await res.text();
        if (text && text.length > 0) return text;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // fall through to proxies
    }
    // Try CORS proxies
    for (const proxyFn of CORS_PROXIES) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(proxyFn(url), { cache: "no-store" });
        if (res.ok) {
          const text = await res.text();
          if (text && text.length > 0) return text;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // try next proxy
      }
    }
    throw new Error("All fetch attempts failed (CORS or network)");
  };

  // ---------- CSS ----------
  const css = `
  .rc-modal-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1000; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; animation: rcFade .18s ease; }

  const styleEl = document.createElement("style");

  const renderConfigs = (configs, subUrl, subName) => {

  // ---------- Browser-side ping ----------
  const pingHost = async (host, port) => {
    const url = `https://${host}:${port}/`;
    const samples = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      try {
        await fetch(url + "?_=" + Date.now() + "-" + i, {
          mode: "no-cors",
          cache: "no-store",
          method: "HEAD",
        });
        const t1 = performance.now();
        samples.push(t1 - t0);
      } catch (e) {
        const t1 = performance.now();
        samples.push(t1 - t0);
      }
    }
    if (!samples.length) return null;
    samples.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return samples[Math.floor(samples.length / 2)];
  };

  // ---------- Augment subscription cards ----------
  const augmentSubCard = (card) => {
    if (card.dataset.rcAugmented) return;
    const copyBtn = card.querySelector("[data-copy]");
    if (!copyBtn) return;
    const subUrl = copyBtn.getAttribute("data-copy");
    if (!subUrl || subUrl === "#" || subUrl.length < 10) return;
    const name = card.querySelector("h3")?.textContent?.trim() || "sub";

    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "btn btn-secondary rc-configs-btn";
    btn.textContent = "Show configs";
    btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      showConfigs(subUrl, name);
    });
    card.appendChild(btn);
    card.dataset.rcAugmented = "1";
  };

  const augmentProxyCard = (card) => {
    if (card.dataset.rcPingAugmented) return;
    const mono = card.querySelector(".font-mono");
    if (!mono) return;
    const text = mono.textContent.trim();
    const m = text.match(/^([\w.\-]+):(\d+)/);
    if (!m) return;
    const host = m[1];
    const port = m[2];

    const dot = document.createElement("span");
    dot.className = "rc-ping-dot rc-ping-loading";
    dot.title = "Testing...";

    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.textContent = "ping...";
    label.style.fontSize = "12px";
    label.style.color = "#9ca3af";
    label.style.fontFamily = '"JetBrains Mono", monospace';

    const wrap = document.createElement("span");
    wrap.style.display = "inline-flex";
    wrap.style.alignItems = "center";
    wrap.style.gap = "6px";
    wrap.style.marginLeft = "10px";
    wrap.appendChild(dot);
    wrap.appendChild(label);

    const pingRow = card.querySelector(".flex.items-center.gap-2.mt-3");
    if (pingRow) {
      pingRow.appendChild(wrap);
    }

    pingHost(host, port).then((rtt) => {
      dot.classList.remove("rc-ping-loading");
      if (rtt === null) {
        dot.classList.add("rc-ping-bad");
        label.textContent = "n/a";
        return;
      }
      const ms = Math.round(rtt);
      label.textContent = `${ms} ms`;
      if (ms < 150) dot.classList.add("rc-ping-good");
      else if (ms < 400) dot.classList.add("rc-ping-medium");
      else dot.classList.add("rc-ping-bad");
    });

    card.dataset.rcPingAugmented = "1";
  };

  // ---------- MutationObserver ----------
  const observe = () => {
    const subsGrid = document.getElementById("subsGrid");
    const proxiesList = document.getElementById("proxiesList");

    const scan = (root) => {
      if (!root) return;
      root.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach((c) => {
        if (c.closest("#subsGrid")) augmentSubCard(c);
        if (c.closest("#proxiesList")) augmentProxyCard(c);
      });
    };

    scan(subsGrid);
    scan(proxiesList);

    const mo = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
      for (const mut of mutations) {
        for (const node of mut.addedNodes) {
          if (node.nodeType !== 1) continue;
          if (node.classList?.contains("card")) {
            if (node.closest("#subsGrid")) augmentSubCard(node);
            if (node.closest("#proxiesList")) augmentProxyCard(node);
          } else {
            scan(node.parentElement);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    if (subsGrid) mo.observe(subsGrid, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    if (proxiesList) mo.observe(proxiesList, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", observe);
  } else {
    setTimeout(observe, 500);
  }
})();
=== ./docs/speedtest-fix.js ===
// Speed Test Upload Fix - вставить в docs/index.html вместо функции measureUpload()

async function measureUpload() {
    els.speedPhase.textContent = "Measuring upload...";
    setGauge(0, "upload");
    
    const chunkSize = 256 * 1024; // 256KB chunks
    const chunk = new Uint8Array(chunkSize);
    crypto.getRandomValues(chunk);
    
    const totalChunks = Math.floor(SPEED.maxUploadBytes / chunkSize);
    const parts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < totalChunks; i++) parts.push(chunk);
    const bigPayload = new Blob(parts);
    
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        const start = performance.now();
        let lastReport = start;
        let lastLoaded = 0;
        
        xhr.upload.addEventListener("progress", (e) => {
            if (state.speedAbort) {
                xhr.abort();
                resolve(null);
                return;
            }
            
            const now = performance.now();
            if (e.lengthComputable && now - lastReport > 200) {
                const elapsed = (now - lastReport) / 1000;
                const uploaded = e.loaded - lastLoaded;
                const instantMbps = formatMbps(uploaded / elapsed);
                
                setGauge(instantMbps, "upload");
                speedLog(`upload ${Math.round(e.loaded / 1024)} KB / ${Math.round(e.total / 1024)} KB`, `${instantMbps.toFixed(2)} Mbps`);
                
                lastReport = now;
                lastLoaded = e.loaded;
            }
        });
        
        xhr.addEventListener("load", () => {
            const totalElapsed = (performance.now() - start) / 1000;
            const bytes = bigPayload.size;
            
            if (totalElapsed <= 0 || bytes <= 0) {
                resolve(null);
                return;
            }
            
            const mbps = formatMbps(bytes / totalElapsed);
            setGauge(mbps, "upload");
            speedLog(`upload complete ${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`, `${mbps.toFixed(2)} Mbps`);
            resolve(mbps);
        });
        
        xhr.addEventListener("error", () => {
            speedLog("upload", "network error");
            resolve(null);
        });
        
        xhr.addEventListener("abort", () => {
            speedLog("upload", "aborted");
            resolve(null);
        });
        
        xhr.open("POST", SPEED.uploadUrl, true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream");
        xhr.send(bigPayload);
    });
}

HARVEST_KEYS = {
    "name",
    "repo",
    "full_name",
    "description",
    "topics",
    "platform_labels",
    "protocol_hint",
    "region_hint",
    "query_slug",
    "last_commit_message",
    "secret_type",
}

WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,}|[А-Яа-яЁё]{3,}")


# =========================================================
# 2. Утилиты
# =========================================================

def collapse_spaces(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value or "").strip()


def make_query_id(query: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.md5(query.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]


def normalize_for_dedupe(query: str) -> str:
    return collapse_spaces(query.lower())


def build_query(*parts) -> str:
    cleaned = []

    for part in parts:
        if not part:
            continue

        if isinstance(part, (list, tuple, set)):
            part = " ".join(str(x) for x in part if x)

        part = collapse_spaces(str(part))

        if part:
            cleaned.append(part)

    return collapse_spaces(" ".join(cleaned))


def make_entry(category: str, qtype: str, query: str, priority: int, reason: str, qualifiers=None) -> dict:
    query = collapse_spaces(query)

    if not query:
        return None

    qualifiers = qualifiers or []

    full_query_parts = [query]

    if qualifiers:
        full_query_parts.extend(qualifiers)

    full_query = collapse_spaces(" ".join(full_query_parts))

    return {
        "id": make_query_id(full_query),
        "category": category,
        "type": qtype,
        "query": query,
        "full_query": full_query,
        "qualifiers": qualifiers,
        "priority": int(priority),
        "reason": reason,
    }


def finalize_entries(entries, limit: int, category: str, qtype: str):
    seen = set()
    unique = []

    for entry in entries:
        if not entry:
            continue

        key = normalize_for_dedupe(entry["full_query"])

        if key in seen:
            continue

        seen.add(key)
        unique.append(entry)

    # Небольшой шум для разнообразия при одинаковом приоритете
    for entry in unique:
        entry["_noise"] = random.random()

    unique.sort(
        key=lambda x: (
            x["priority"],
            x["_noise"],
        ),
        reverse=True,
    )

    if limit > 0 and len(unique) > limit:
        unique = unique[:limit]

    result = []

    for idx, entry in enumerate(unique, start=1):
        entry.pop("_noise", None)
        entry["slug"] = f"{category}-{qtype}-{idx:04d}"
        result.append(entry)

    return result


# =========================================================
# 3. Автоадаптация по уже найденным данным
# =========================================================

def harvest_value(value, counter: Counter):
    if value is None:
        return

    if isinstance(value, str):
        words = WORD_RE.findall(value.lower())

        for word in words:
            word = word.strip()

            if len(word) < 3:
                continue

            if word in STOPWORDS:
                continue

            counter[word] += 1

    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        for item in value:
            harvest_value(item, counter)


def harvest_terms_from_json(obj, counter: Counter):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for key, value in obj.items():
            if key in HARVEST_KEYS:
                harvest_value(value, counter)
            else:
                harvest_terms_from_json(value, counter)

    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for item in obj:
            harvest_terms_from_json(item, counter)


def load_adaptive_terms(paths, top_n: int = 80):
    counter = Counter()

    for path in paths:
        if not path:
            continue

        if not os.path.exists(path):
            continue

        try:
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            harvest_terms_from_json(data, counter)
            print(f"[+] Harvested terms from: {path}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[!] Failed to harvest {path}: {e}")

    terms = [word for word, _ in counter.most_common(top_n)]
    print(f"[+] Adaptive terms loaded: {len(terms)}")

    return terms


# =========================================================
# 4. Генерация запросов для целевого репозитория
# =========================================================

def generate_target_queries(target: str, aliases=None):
    entries = []

    if not target:
        return entries

    aliases = aliases or []

    variants = set()

    base = collapse_spaces(target)

    if base:
        variants.add(base)
        variants.add(base.lower())
        variants.add(base.upper())
        variants.add(base.replace(" ", "-"))
        variants.add(base.replace(" ", "_"))
        variants.add(base.replace(" ", ""))
        variants.add(base.replace("-", " "))
        variants.add(base.replace("_", " "))

    for alias in aliases:
        alias = collapse_spaces(alias)

        if not alias:
            continue

        variants.add(alias)
        variants.add(alias.lower())
        variants.add(alias.replace(" ", "-"))
        variants.add(alias.replace(" ", "_"))
        variants.add(alias.replace(" ", ""))

    variants = sorted(variants)

    for variant in variants:
        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f'"{variant}" in:name',
                priority=100,
                reason="target exact name",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f'"{variant}" in:name,description,readme',
                priority=98,
                reason="target name/description/readme",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f'"{variant}" mirror',
                priority=95,
                reason="target mirror",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f'"{variant}" fork',
                priority=90,
                reason="target fork",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f'"{variant}" alternative',
                priority=85,
                reason="target alternative",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f'"{variant}" release',
                priority=80,
                reason="target release",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="code",
                query=f'"{variant}"',
                priority=92,
                reason="target code mention",
            )
        )

    # Если target указан как owner/repo
    if "/" in base:
        owner, repo = base.split("/", 1)

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f"user:{owner}",
                priority=99,
                reason="target owner",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

        entries.append(
            make_entry(
                category="target",
                qtype="repo",
                query=f"{owner} {repo}",
                priority=99,
                reason="target owner repo",
                qualifiers=["fork:true", "archived:false"],
            )
        )

    return finalize_entries(entries, limit=500, category="target", qtype="mixed")
